name: Marlin Masters

features.name: Fisherman
features.description: Collects every Marlin with a multiplier of up to 20x.

features.name: LootLines
features.description: Three or more Marlins on a line also pay.

review:
The original deep-sea collect game that led to Atlantis. Marlins show cash prizes from 1x to 1,000x, and you win them through a Fisherman – who collects every marlin and can add a multiplier of up to 20x – or a LootLine of three or more.

Nice detail: big values are shortened on screen, but Hacksaw says the amount shown is the minimum you'll get. The 7,500x max is lower than the sequel's, making this the gentler of the two.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
